src: APPSC Group-II Mains 2025
s: Who was the first Telugu writer to win the Jnanpith Award for the work titled "Ramayana Kalpavriksham"?
x:
Viswanatha Satyanarayana became the first Telugu writer to receive the Jnanpith Award, India's highest literary honour, for his monumental work Ramayana Kalpavriksham. The work is regarded as one of the greatest literary reinterpretations of the Ramayana in Telugu and reflects Viswanatha's profound scholarship, classical style and philosophical depth. Besides this masterpiece, he authored numerous novels, poems, dramas and literary essays, making him one of the most prolific writers in Telugu literature. Later, Dr. C. Narayana Reddy also received the Jnanpith Award for his poetic work Viswambhara, but he was not the first Telugu recipient. Hence, the correct answer is Option (3).
Exam Note:
• First Telugu Jnanpith Awardee – Viswanatha Satyanarayana
• Award-winning Work – Ramayana Kalpavriksham
• Later Telugu Jnanpith Awardee – C. Narayana Reddy (Viswambhara)
